name: Seeder
whatItIs: Deterministic random numbers with named sub-streams. Each consumer (loot, level layout, combat rolls) forks its own stream from the main seed, so adding an enemy never shifts later loot drops and saved runs stay reproducible.
gotchas: Never share one stream between two consumers; fork by name.
Key per-entity streams by a stable uid (e.g. loot:<enemyUid>), not by spawn order.
